title: paralasianthus brevipes

The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
